title: Optimizing Experimental Design for Causal Effect Estimation with Partial Measurements
summary: Instrumental variable regression quantifies causal effects between a possibly confounded treatment variable $ X_2 $ and a response variable $ X_3 $ by leveraging an instrument $ X_1 $. Our work considers the setting where some prior information of the joint distribution of $ X_{123} $ is given, potentially through an initial dataset. However, further samples must be gathered to improve the accuracy of the estimation.
